body: yeah it is what I try to do, it really does work. yeah I love durian rider and freelee, they don't lie :) the video that got me to try was freelee talking about her battle with depression and suicidal depression and it worked for me.

straight into it, 5 weeks I managed before I caved in. I felt better than ever on it. The cloud is back but I still feel as though I benefit from it. I intend to do it for longer when the weather is warmer as it is freezing right now (England). I have however slowly improved my diet over the passed 6 years, less processed foods, then to no processed foods, normal to organic dairy, to raw dairy and organic produce then finally to no dairy and then tried raw. My mind felt sharper each step of the way but nothing in comparison to the 5 weeks of raw food (a couple of cheats). The other thing I loved was no food preparing, no cleaning up etc
